utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, I believe the drive is at the community center parking lot, not your place. Can we confirm the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, Eli, I thought I mentioned it earlier—it's at my place this time. My garage is bigger, and we have more room for tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, I'm pretty sure the flyer says the community center parking lot. Let's stick to the original plan to avoid confusion.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that sounds important. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's this Saturday morning where everyone brings broken items and we fix them together as a community. It's a great way to save stuff from the trash and get to know your neighbors!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, fixing things together! That sounds wonderful. Where exactly is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I've got the details: Saturday 10-4 at the community center. I'll check on a backup plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And what about the parts? Are we sure we have everything we need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the list of parts we have. Can you remind me what's missing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mara, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I heard it's this weekend! Tool check is Saturday morning at the community shed, not the center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the shed? I must've mixed that up. Is the repair drive still at the community center though?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Glad to hear it's going well. I'll swing by if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, it's at the community center from 10 to 4. Bring something to fix!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was at the parking lot? But okay, community center works.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We could really use more hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! Yes, I'll definitely be there. It's this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center parking lot, right? I've been telling everyone I know to come join us!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn! Actually it's from 10 to 4 at the community center itself, not the parking lot. But we're glad you're coming!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey everyone! Just a quick reminder that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Let's all adjust our plans!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. Did I miss a memo?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it changed. Sorry for the confusion, Dane. I'll send out an updated flyer to make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Kira, I think Vik means the same event—the repair drive is the tool check meeting. We're fixing items together, so both are the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, exactly! So let's meet at the shed Saturday, 10 to 4, to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I'll be there with my toolbox and some extra screws.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what kind of stuff are people bringing to fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just small appliances, clothes, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we need to bring any tools ourselves?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning! I just wanted to confirm the tool check for the repair drive is Saturday at the community shed, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, I thought the repair drive is at the community center, not the shed. Are you sure about the tool check?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm certain, Rey. Vik confirmed it's at the community shed, all day Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, thanks Leo! I'll manage the drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, let me know if you need tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo! I'll let you know if we need anything. The drive is at the community center parking lot at 10am.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to work? I've heard some things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't worry Kira, it's at Gus's place this weekend and he's really organized. I bet it'll be great!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought it was at the community center, not Gus's place. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's from 10 to 4 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Wait, Cleo, I thought it was at my place this Saturday? We might have mixed up the location.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, no, Gus—I'm sorry for the confusion. I've got it down as the community center this Saturday. Did we say something different before?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's Saturday morning at the shed. Need any tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, Leo, it's at the community center, not the shed. Starts at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So the tool check is Saturday from 10 to 4 at the shed? I'll bring my tools and hope someone has a spare screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, the repair drive is at the community center parking lot, not the shed. Does 10am still work for you, or will the tool check conflict?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought the tool check was at the shed? Are they in different places?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mina, I just found out the repair drive is actually at Gus's house this weekend, not the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Changed to Gus's place? Did they send out the new address?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, they sent an email this morning with the updated address. I'll forward it to you!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I heard it's at the community center parking lot from 9 to 3. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to hear, Rey! See you there. Don't forget to tell your friends!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Quinn. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, sorry I'm late. So it's a repair drive, not a potluck? What are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's this Saturday at Gus's house, starting at 10am. We're fixing old bikes and appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, at Gus's house? I thought it was at the community center. Did the location change?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. Ira confirmed it—they'll fix gadgets on the spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, this Saturday? I thought it was next month. Are you sure?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'm certain. Ira said it's this Saturday, 10 to 4, at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I thought it was at Gus's place, but now I'm hearing it's at the community center. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, I thought it was at the parking lot this Saturday. Maybe I got it wrong, but that's what I recall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, just to confirm, the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, Hana, I thought the repair drive was at Gus's place this weekend. And we have a tool check meeting Saturday morning at the community shed. Let me check the latest plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so you're saying the repair drive is at Gus's place now, and there's a tool check at the community shed? Let me double-check the latest flyer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday morning? It's going to be a great community event!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there! I'm also planning to attend the tool check meeting at the community shed Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, that's perfect! We can head over together after the tool check.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I think I got the day wrong earlier — the repair drive is actually this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, I thought it was Saturday. Are you sure it's Sunday now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it's definitely Sunday. I made a mistake earlier—sorry for the confusion.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Vik, just so you know, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, I thought it was Saturday at the shed? Are you sure it's Sunday now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm sure! It was changed to Sunday at the community center. I'll send out a reminder to everyone.
